verdict.rationale: Warp's docs describe MCP servers as "essentially acting as plugins for Warp," which can expose custom tools written in any language. However, these extend only the AI agents, not the terminal itself. The other related items are thin: Warp Drive offers saved, parameterized workflows, and a newly shipped settings file gives programmatic control over settings. Missing for 10: a documented terminal-level scripting or plugin API in a real language (Lua/Python/kittens-style), hooks into terminal events, rendering, or keybindings, and any hands-on or community corroboration of terminal extensibility.
